Package com.neueda.leap.order.model

Class Quote

java.lang.Object
com.neueda.leap.order.model.Quote
@Entity public class Quote extends Object
Quote entity representing a market quote for a security. BR-08: Non-stale quotes used for order execution pricing. BR-13: Quotes provide indicative bid/ask prices for order display.
